text: Pellet,wennjirooɓe e Aayeeje Allah ɗen,fii bonnitirgol ɗe ko aldaa e hujja wanaa daliil,ko fii tun faale townitagol mawnintinanoo goonga kan, kono ɓe hewtataa e ko ɓe faalaa kon.An Nulaaɗo,moolor Allah,tawde pellet,ko Kanko woni Nanoowo haalaaji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen,Yi'oowo kuuɗemaɓɓe.Huunde e ɗin suuɗaaki Mo,O yoɓitoyay ɓe ɗum.
